title: Store Repair Warranty Terms and Goodwill Approval Limits — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
The store repair warranty on customer-pay repairs, and the goodwill a service advisor or the desk may grant without a manager, under **Service Accounts and Repair Orders**:

| Tier | Repair warranty (months from the repair's line date) | Repair warranty (miles beyond the repair's odometer) | Labor credited on a comeback inside the warranty | Goodwill limit per repair order (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Service Guest Account | 12 | 12000 | 100% | 50.00 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 12 | 12000 | 100% | 100.00 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold | 12 | 12000 | 100% | 150.00 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | 24 | 24000 | 100% | 250.00 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | 12 | 12000 | 100% | 250.00 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | 12 | 12000 | 100% | 250.00 |

The months and the miles are two limits of the same warranty, and the warranty ends at whichever is reached first.

**Hypothetical.** A repair on an account at Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum with the odometer at 41000 miles is covered up to 65000 miles and for 24 months from its line date; at the other tiers the same repair is covered up to 53000 miles and for 12 months.
